verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs and README state that taps, clicks, momentum scrolling, an on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text, and Apple Pencil as the pointer all act on the Mac. An attached keyboard types on the Mac with Esc and shortcuts included, and three-finger swipes and pinches trigger Mission Control and Spaces as a Mac trackpad does. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a physical mouse connected to the iPad, documentation of how events are injected as native host events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
